# Code of Conduct

## Our Standard

EasyDeployerHub is a technical project, and discussion should stay respectful,
clear, and focused on improving the work.

Examples of helpful behavior:

- using welcoming and professional language;
- giving feedback that is specific and actionable;
- respecting different levels of experience;
- assuming good intent while asking for clarification when needed;
- keeping discussions focused on the project.

Examples of behavior that is not acceptable:

- personal attacks, insults, or harassment;
- discriminatory language or behavior;
- publishing private information without permission;
- repeated off-topic or disruptive comments;
- hostile responses to review or maintenance decisions.

## Scope

This code of conduct applies to project spaces such as issues, pull requests,
discussions, and any other official project communication channels.

## Reporting

If you see behavior that makes participation difficult or unsafe, please contact
the maintainer privately with a short description and any relevant links or
screenshots.

Reports will be reviewed with care. The maintainer may remove comments, close
threads, block users, or take other reasonable steps to keep the project
welcoming and productive.

## Goal

The goal is simple: keep collaboration respectful, useful, and focused on
building a better project.
